finding: COLLINEARITY EXPLAINS THE FLIP (SUPPORTED). The cda_diff coefficient is positive (+0.478 std), which is physically backwards -- more drag should hurt. But with only 3 cars, drag is nearly collinear with power (r=0.96) and risk (r=0.94); power and risk correlate at r=1.00. The genuinely predictive, physically-correct signals (power+, risk+) load onto these correlated axes; L2 regularization (C=0.1) then splits the shared weight and lets drag absorb a positive sign it does not causally deserve. Permutation importance ranks features by real predictive contribution as risk_diff > power_diff_kw > hov_eligible_diff > mass_diff_kg > cda_diff_m2, which does not mirror the distorted raw-coefficient magnitudes -- the signature of collinearity. SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK: reflects SimZoner physics engine v1, not real vehicles.
caveat: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK: measures agreement with SimZoner physics engine v1, not real vehicles. Only 3 cars generate all pairwise diffs.
